getAuthorityKeyIdentifier(bytes).details: according to RFC 5280, the Authority Key Identifier is mandatory for CA certificatesif not present, this method returns 0x00

getSubjectKeyIdentifier(bytes).details: according to RFC 5280, the Subject Key Identifier is RECOMMENDED for CA certificatesIntel DCAP attestation certificates contain this extensionthis value can be useful for checking CRLs without performing signature verification, which can be costly in terms of gaswe can simply use this value to check against the CRL's authority key identifierif not present, this method returns 0x00
